evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented distinction enacts market-pricing: intelligence framed as property acquired versus leased, a proportionality between payment form and possession.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Commodity/asset framing performs market-pricing — proportionality between what is fungible and priced versus what is retained as proprietary value.
Naming a thesis about ownership of intelligence carries the same market-pricing proportionality — the relational move is ownership-based allocation of cognitive value.
